title: Light Duty Diesel Performance
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Light Duty Diesel Performance Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to demonstrate proficiency in technical skills and safety principles required for employment in the transportation and related industries performing diesel performance work.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to assess, evaluate, and solve diesel performance problems common to automotive, industrial, and agricultural industries.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to demonstrate core diesel performance skills required for industry success and certification.

notes: The catalog prints course codes without a space (e.g. 'AUTOB20'); these match closed-list codes AUTO B20, AUTO B30, AUTO B33 and AUTO B36.
Each printed outcome begins with 'Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to'; this phrase is part of each numbered outcome as printed, so it was kept.

Careers recorded are the industries named for entry level employment ('Transportation Industry and Automotive Industry'); the description also mentions oil fields, agriculture industry and other transportation fields as places diesel vehicles are used, not as careers.
